title: Pure Flame Swordsman
summary: Pure Flame Swordsman and Salamandra beatdown build, centering Joey Wheeler's classic Warrior with modern legacy support and staples. The deck cheats original Flame Swordsman from the Extra Deck to fuel quick-effect summons, equip synergies, and destructive attacks under Ultimate Flame Swordsman.

summary.title: Starters
points: Dark Flare Swordsman sends Flame Swordsman directly from the Extra Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself, then Tributes itself on either turn to summon Fighting Flame Swordsman, Mirage Swordsman, or Salamandra, the Flying Flame Dragon from the Deck.

Fighting Flame Swordsman searches a Spell or Trap mentioning Flame Swordsman (such as Flame Swordsrealm or Fighting Flame Sword) on Normal or Special Summon, and sends a Flame Swordsman monster from the Deck to the GY when sent to the GY.
Fighting Flame Sword adds any card mentioning Flame Swordsman from the Deck to the hand while equipping a FIRE Warrior, or boosts ATK and destroys an opponent's card during battle.

summary.title: Opening: Dark Flare Swordsman
steps: Special Summon Dark Flare Swordsman from your hand by sending Flame Swordsman from the Extra Deck to the GY.
Tribute Dark Flare Swordsman as a Quick Effect to Special Summon Fighting Flame Swordsman from your Deck.
Trigger Fighting Flame Swordsman to add Flame Swordsrealm from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Flame Swordsrealm and pay 1000 LP to Special Summon a second Flame Swordsman from the Extra Deck without Fusion Materials.
Equip Salamandra, the Flying Flame Dragon from hand or GY to Flame Swordsman, preparing to climb into Ultimate Flame Swordsman via Salamandra Fusion or Fighting Flame Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ultimate Flame Swordsman is the primary boss: it sends an equip card to the GY to destroy an opponent's monster and inflict 500 damage, acting as a Quick Effect while equipped.

Fighting Flame Dragon equips itself to a Warrior Fusion Monster to grant a second attack each Battle Phase and can banish itself from the GY to revive a Level 7 or lower Flame Swordsman Fusion Monster.
Ferocious Flame Swordsman gives all Warriors on the field a 500 ATK boost and floats into a non-Link Warrior in your GY if destroyed by battle or card effect.
Mirage Swordsman revives itself whenever a FIRE Fusion Monster is destroyed and floats into a Level 7 or lower Flame Swordsman monster from your hand, Deck, or GY if sent to the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Flame Swordsrealm shields your FIRE Warriors from having their Normal Summons negated and summons Flame Swordsman once per turn directly from the Extra Deck.
Salamandra Fusion equips to a Flame Swordsman or monster mentioning it, boosting ATK by 700 and enabling Fusion Summons by shuffling materials into the Deck.
Salamandra with Chain equips to a monster to grant 700 ATK, turns an opponent's monster face-down, and banishes itself from the GY to Fusion Summon by shuffling materials.
Flame Swordsdance summons a Flame Swordsman Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck when a monster is Special Summoned, or destroys an opponent's card when banished from the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Infernoble Knight and Fire King engines are left out in favor of a pure build. Metalflame Swordsman is omitted because it requires the Red-Eyes Trap Max Metalmorph.
